fields.title: Epochs
fields.description: Specifies the number of epochs to train.

fields.title: Output dimensions
fields.description: Specifies the dimension of the mapped output data.

fields.title: Learning rate
fields.description:
Specifies the learning rate to use. The learning rate is decreased automatically
over the trained epochs.

fields.title: Random seed
fields.description:
Specifies the random seed to use, which allows to reproduce a mapping even if the
initialization is done randomly.

fields.title: Use all rows
fields.description:
If enabled, all rows in the input table will be used for the MDS computation.
If disabled, only the specified number of rows will be used.

fields.title: Number of rows to use
fields.description: Specifies the number of rows to apply the MDS on.

fields.title: Distance matrix column
fields.description: The column containing the distance vectors of the original high dimensional data to map.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица
